title: Earliest music memories: Roy Palmer and neighbours in New Orleans
summary: His first music was neighbour Roy Palmer on bass fiddle and mandolin at fish fries, plus Sammy Stewart's band and other neighbourhood players.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Yeah. If you can go back to your earliest memories, the very first music you ever heard.

Well the very first music I ever heard, we'll deviate a little bit and go back to New Orleans. See I'm a little ahead of myself. The very first one was, I'm very fortunate all the way around Bill, because I lived on Palmer's Avenue and I knew Roy Palmer when he was playing the bass fiddle. I must have been before five years old. And we lived right across the street from one another when I was nothing but a kid. From Roy Palmer.
He really followed you around. He played for my mother during that time.

You see how far I was ahead of my story. He played for my mother on Palmer's Avenue for the fish fries. He was playing the Heller Mandolin and he played bass fiddle then. You see Roy is a musician of many instruments.
Yeah, I know he teaches all that.

And I saw Roy a little later in the arms playing the baritone, I think in the Arnold band. So these things just begin to, you'll have to pardon me because it just began to come to me. That was Sammy Stewart's band was at the old Sunset. You said Stewart. Now that's come to me now. And so we were renting from some people to call their liveazos. And the B-sants was right across the street. They were becoming great ball players, champion B-sants. So I'll go on back to the music now. So there was Nene Bryant, the drummer, and James Williams, he was tabbed for a great. And he left New York with the California League. He died out there. He was tabbed for to be a great clarinet player, I mean right in the same category as Tio and the rest of them. He was young because I saw him. And while attending Tomlin Foreign School every year.
